neighbours.label: the connector between two identical items: a tied score ('3-3') or 'X by X' / 'X für X'
fire: The game ended in a 4-4 draw.
The score was tied 2-2 in the sixth.
Step by step the work got done.
Inch by inch the boat moved.
Word for word he copied the text.
Schritt für Schritt erklärt er die Regeln.
Year by year the forest grew.
The game stood at 5-5 at the half.
quiet: The game ended in a 4-1 defeat.
The score was 6-2 in the sixth.
With care he copied the text.
Mit Geduld erklärt er die Regeln.
The game stood at 5-2 at the half.

notes: Probes were not fully clean: '3-1' reached 0.55 although '4-2' and '2-0' were at 0.00, and 'City drew 1-1' was at 0.00. 'Higher and higher' reached only 0.18, so ' and' fits this less well than ' by'. I tested the repeated-pair pattern on new cases as AGENTS.md asks, rather than listing tokens.
